title: ai-badger hook command shapes
description: The command shapes a hooks-manifest.json entry selects by `script`, rewritten into an agent's own config (.claude/settings.json, .github/hooks/). Lives at features/<stack>/hooks/hooks.json. Not to be confused with the sibling hooks-manifest.json, which declares which hooks exist and which agents receive them.

hooks.description: Hook event name (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd, ...) -> the matcher groups fired on it.

matcher.description: Agent-side matcher expression (e.g. 'startup|resume', 'Edit|Write'). Absent means every occurrence of the event.

command.description: Shell command. A path under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/features/common/skills/ is rewritten to the project's .ai-badger/skills/ copy at scaffold time.
